text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I OBJECT!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Deceived by the polite knock at the
door, I
quickly learn it has come from
none other than
Curren Chan.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This cutesy Umamusume is Admire
Vega's
roommate. And the second she's
entered the
room, she announces her
disapproval.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Obviously this is about Ayabe's training
schedule,
duh!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
You and I both probably know how
serious Ayabe
is about running, right?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Did you know she rejects my invites to
eat
together four out of five times?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
And whenever I ask her why, she always
says it's
because she wants to do some
extra training.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Well, now with her current training
schedule, it's
gotten even worse! Every
day! Every single day
she leaves before I
wake up and gets back after I
go to
sleep!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Even on the weekends! I mean, seriously!
The list
of videos I want to show her is
getting way too
long.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Don't you think you're being too tough
with her?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I turn pale upon hearing this. I knew she
was really
motivated for the Hopeful
Stakes...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But I can't believe she's been pushing
herself to
do extra training on her own,
on top of the
difficult regimen we've
been doing together.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
You know, it doesn't surprise me she's
never said
anything.
choice_data_list: (I have to do something right away...!)

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ayabe's waaay too tenacious for her own
good.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: It's a good thing I came then, right? You'll take care of it, right?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: You are her trainer, after all. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Well, now it's clear that Admire Vega
has been
overexerting herself. I need to
get her to take it
easy a little.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I think back on my experiences with her,
although
there isn't much to reflect on...
Luckily, something
comes to mind.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: You want to go to the planetarium?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Where is this coming from?
choice_data_list: Right, there's a section that was completely renovated.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Without revealing what Curren Chan
told me, I
politely express my concerns
that she might be
feeling overworked as
of late.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I don't think this is the right time to
relax—
choice_data_list: I think taking a breather is necessary if you want to keep running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I send Admire Vega a link to the
planetarium's
website through the LANE
messaging app.
choice_data_list: Even if you're not interested, could you at least take a look?
Even if you're not interested, want to at least take a look?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With a sigh, she takes out her
smartphone and we
look at the site
together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Since the planetarium's renovations,
they've
added a state-of-the-art
projector and large
cushion seats that
they claim are "as comfortable
as sitting
on a cloud."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
choice_data_list: Since we had the chance, I went ahead and got us cushioned seats.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: You mean you already bought tickets?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In fact, since then, the tickets have been
fully
booked.
choice_data_list: It's so popular, I thought we had to hurry...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Maybe this is all a bit too abrupt for
her... I tell
her to forget about the
tickets and decide
whether she wants to
go.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I won't do it at the expense of training.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
But if we finish up a little earlier than
usual...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: It wouldn't hurt.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Great! My plan to get Admire Vega to
try and
relax worked out!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: These are the cushioned seats...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: So it seems.
choice_data_list: Looks like we can watch it lying down.
Looks like you can watch it lying down.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: It's made of velour...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: And inside is... yep—microbeads.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: It's so soft...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (Almost... like a fluffy cloud...)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the train back to the academy...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...You asleep?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Are you asleep?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm surprised by her sudden question.
But she
doesn't seem to be looking my
way as she asks it
again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Perhaps that means she wants me to be asleep. I decide to remain silent and close my eyes once more.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Seems like you're asleep. Good.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...You're a difficult person to
understand, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I hardly ever talk to you. So you
shouldn't really
know anything about
me.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
There's something like... a lingering
shadow inside
me.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
The shadow is my sister—I told you
about her
before—the one who died
instead of me.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
My heart beats in excitement when I
race. When I
win, I'm overwhelmed with
joy.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
It makes me think that... she would have
really
loved to run.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: That's why...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I want to run and win... because she
wanted to but
couldn't.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I want to devote everything I can to the
fragment
of her that lives on inside me.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
This doesn't have anything to do with
you,
though... It's not a burden you need
to bear.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
So... that's why I'm telling you while
you're asleep.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I'm looking forward to training tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With my eyes still closed, she remains
silent for a
moment as the train
continues into the night.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I decide to "wake up" as we approach
the station
closest to the school.

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Sister
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Sister
text_block_list.text: So... that's my sister's trainer.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ahhh... The weather's so nice today.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Oh! Ayabe?! You're still here.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Good morning... Is it a problem that I
am?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
No problem at all! It's just... you're
always already
out training by now!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
You've got your uniform on... Are you
actually
planning to skip running and go
straight to class?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...I guess so.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Come on... Don't make this awkward for
me...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, okay, let's head to class together
then! ♪
Hang on just a sec, I'll be ready
soon!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I'm not waiting.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yes you are! I'm gonna get ready in front
of the
door so you can't leave.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Cut it out... What if someone tries to
open the
door?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Five minutes. I won't wait any longer.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Kaaay! ♪
